title: ever ESMÉE|Pleated Double V-Neck Long Sleeves Shiny Belt Chiffon Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a stunning entrance at your next special event in our Pleated Double V-Neck Long Sleeves Shiny Belt Chiffon Evening Dress. The flowing chiffon fabric drapes beautifully, while the pleated details add a touch of sophistication. With its double V-neckline and shiny belt, this dress is ideal for glamorous occasions, like weddings or cocktail parties. Step into the spotlight and exude confidence in this exquisite evening dress.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style:Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
